data_fields.name: force_respawn_s
data_fields.donor_constant: g_forcerespawn cvar, default 20 (0 disables the forced respawn)

data_fields.name: pick_fraction
data_fields.donor_constant: index in [0, floor(n/2)) of the furthest-first ranking

data_fields.name: spot_no_bots_no_humans
data_fields.donor_constant: per spot flags (excludes a spot for bots or for humans)

best_idea: A respawn goes to one of the spots furthest from where the player last stood, skipping spots a living player blocks, after a short death lock, with a forced respawn when the player waits too long.
decision_why: Take the furthest-half pick, the death lock and the server-owned forced-respawn window as zone-data spawn rules; add distance from living enemies, because the donor ranks only by the player's own last position.
acceptance: Server test in a six-spawn zone: the respawn point is among the three furthest from the death point and not within 15 horizontal units of a living player; no respawn accepted before 1.7 s; with no input the player respawns at about 21.7 s.
